svg.text: Testing the plumbing: audience rules with fixtures, and a journey as a state machine the fuzzer can break
collectors: (orders_12m >= 3 and aov > 180) or allocation_list == true
A rule is a predicate in a deliberately tiny language (comparisons, and/or/not, in),
evaluated by an AST-whitelisted interpreter — nothing can hide in a rule.
Cases cover every boundary and every exclusion. Disjointness and size-share tolerance
run against the 600-customer synthetic population. ECC equivalent: unit tests,
written by the model, run by a dumb runner, same answer every time.
timer: a wait edge fires at exactly max_wait_days — like an ESP's wait node
pass trace [open, wait_3d, wait_4d] → reminder → exit_timeout, 2 sends
pass never sends_over_cap · send_to_suppressed · send_outside_window · send_after_end_date
FAIL max_wait_days: 2 → reminder lands on a Friday → send_outside_window 157/2000
FAIL end: 2026-10-15 → reminder after end date → send_after_end_date
The fuzzer's first catch on the example: a 3-day reminder from a Wednesday launch is fine; a 2-day one is a Friday.
